mechanism_narrative: Positive week-over-week momentum in RETAIL_REC itself is an always-on trend: the t-0 mean of -64.6 is 5.7 points above t-1w, and this rebound persists over the next four weeks as consumers resume pre-restriction routines.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -70.3 at t-1w to -64.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean, the momentum hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT recovery above a threshold signals reduced stay-at-home orders; when TRANSIT rises more than 2 points week-over-week, retail footfall follows within four weeks because transit access enables discretionary trips.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 2 points week-over-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -61.3 at t-1w to -59.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT improves by more than 2 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates restored commuting and out-of-home routines; their interaction amplifies retail recovery because workers combine commutes with errands, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility means fewer people are staying home; once RESIDENTIAL falls below +18%, retail-and-recreation trips rise within one week as cabin-fever and errand behavior shifts outward.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from +18.7 at t-1w to +17.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL falls below +18% and mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days does not exceed the last 7-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: Improving GROCERY_PHARM mobility reflects restored consumer willingness to enter stores; this demand spillover lifts RETAIL_REC over two weeks as shopping habits generalize from essentials to discretionary retail.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -34.9 at t-1w to -31.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM improves week-on-week but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than the last 14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility is a seasonal leading indicator: as late-winter daylight increases, outdoor recreation gains spill into retail-and-recreation within four weeks because warmer weather normalizes out-of-home activity.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves by more than 2 points for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -61.3 at t-1w to -58.7 at t-0w
regime_hint: late winter to early spring transition
failure_condition: If PARKS improves by more than 2 points for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-winter-wave reopening regime, WORKPLACES improvement and RESIDENTIAL decline jointly signal relaxed mobility restrictions, which directly permits retail-and-recreation visits to rise over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -53.9 at t-1w to -53.1 at t-0w and RESIDENTIAL fell from +18.7 to +17.4
failure_condition: If in post-winter-wave reopening regime with WORKPLACES > -54% and RESIDENTIAL < +18%, RETAIL_REC over next 28 days is lower than last 28-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT fails to improve while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated above +18%, continued stay-at-home behavior suppresses retail-and-recreation; the interaction of stalled transit and high residential mobility predicts lower RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -59% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -59.1 and RESIDENTIAL at +17.4 at t-0w
regime_hint: tightening restrictions or stall in reopening
failure_condition: If TRANSIT stays below -59% for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than the last 14-day mean, reject.
